findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_map_comments · Private data: commit_version · Public sink: set_performance, set_turnout, share_simulation, roll_up_primary, primary_batch_edit, set_race_scope · Destructive: set_candidates, call_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_map_comments · Private data: commit_version · Public sink: set_performance, set_turnout, share_simulation, roll_up_primary, primary_batch_edit, set_race_scope · Destructive: set_candidates, call_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
